Content Marketing in Ireland
Content that ranks, engages, and converts

Content marketing is the planning and production of articles, guides and pages that rank on Google, get cited by AI tools and bring in leads over time. Khalid Farhan is a Dublin agency that runs content programmes built around keyword research and topical authority, with every piece measured by the traffic and enquiries it produces. We work with businesses in Ireland and across Ireland; most of the work is remote, and we meet Dublin clients in person.

QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK BEFORE HIRING US FOR CONTENT
Answers written and reviewed by Khalid Farhan, founder. Last reviewed November 2026.
How much does Content cost in Ireland?
Retainers from €1,500 a month. The exact figure depends on the size of the opportunity and the amount of work, so we do a free audit first and quote from that. There is no charge for the audit.
Do you work with businesses in Ireland?
Yes. We work with businesses in Ireland and across Ireland. Most of the work is done remotely with regular calls and a monthly report; Dublin-based clients can meet us in person.
How long before content starts ranking?
New content typically takes 3–6 months to rank meaningfully. Well-optimised content on authoritative domains can rank faster.
Do you write the content or do we?
We do. Our content is written by subject matter experts with SEO briefs, not AI-generated and barely edited copy.
How many pieces per month?
Our retainers typically include 4–12 pieces per month depending on budget and goals. Quality always beats quantity.
